title: If I had ... If we went ... etc.
summary: Нереальные или маловероятные ситуации: **If I had a million dollars, I would buy a house** — после **if** прошедшее время, в главной части **would**.
ru:
## Для чего эта конструкция
Мы используем её, когда говорим о воображаемой ситуации, которая сейчас нереальна или маловероятна. По-русски это «если бы ..., то ...».
> **If** I **had** a million dollars, I **would buy** a big house. — Если бы у меня был миллион долларов, я бы купила большой дом.
> **If** I **were** you, I **would** call her. — На твоём месте я бы ей позвонил.

## Правило: if + Past simple, would + глагол
Форма глагола после **if** — Past simple, но значение **не прошлое**, а воображаемое настоящее / будущее.
> If I **lived** in Rome, I'**d** speak Italian. — Если бы я жила в Риме, я бы говорила по-итальянски.
> If we **went** by plane, it **would be** faster. — Если бы мы поехали самолётом, было бы быстрее.

## would — краткая форма и отрицание
- **I'd, you'd, he'd, she'd, we'd, they'd** = would
- **wouldn't** = would not
> If I had more time, I **wouldn't** be so tired. — Если бы у меня было больше времени, я бы так не уставала.

## If I were
После **if** с **I / he / she / it** можно использовать **were**: *If I **were** rich ... / If she **were** here ...* В разговоре часто и **was**: *If I was rich*.
> **If I were you**, I'd take a taxi. — На твоём месте я бы взял такси. (совет)

## Вопросы
> What **would** you do **if** you **won** a lot of money? — Что бы ты сделал, если бы выиграл много денег?
> **Would** you be happy **if** you **lived** abroad? — Yes, I **would**. / No, I **wouldn't**.

## if + will и if + would
- Реальная ситуация: *If I **have** time, I **will** help you.* (возможно)
- Воображаемая: *If I **had** time, I **would** help you.* (но у меня его нет)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~If I would have a car, I would drive.~~ → If I **had** a car, I **would drive**.
- ~~If I had a car, I will go.~~ → ... I **would go**.
- ~~If I am you, I would ...~~ → If I **were** you, I would ...
- ~~What would you do if you would win?~~ → ... if you **won**?
en:
## What is it for?
We use this structure for imaginary or unlikely situations in the present or future.
> **If** I **had** a million dollars, I **would buy** a big house.
> **If** I **were** you, I **would** call her.

## Rule: if + past simple, would + verb
After **if** we use **past simple**, but the meaning is **not past**: it's imaginary.
> If I **lived** in Rome, I'**d** speak Italian.
> If we **went** by plane, it **would be** faster.

## would
- Short forms: **I'd, you'd, he'd, she'd, we'd, they'd**.
- Negative: **wouldn't**.
> If I had more time, I **wouldn't** be so tired.

## If I were
After **if** we can use **were** with **I / he / she / it**. In speaking **was** is also common.
> **If I were you**, I'd take a taxi. (advice)

## Questions
> What **would** you do **if** you **won** a lot of money?
> **Would** you be happy **if** you **lived** abroad? — Yes, I **would**. / No, I **wouldn't**.

## Real and imaginary
- Real: *If I **have** time, I **will** help you.* (it's possible)
- Imaginary: *If I **had** time, I **would** help you.* (but I haven't)

## Common mistakes
- ~~If I would have a car, I would drive.~~ → If I **had** a car, I **would drive**.
- ~~If I had a car, I will go.~~ → ... I **would go**.
- ~~If I am you ...~~ → If I **were** you ...
structure:
## Схема
| if-часть | Главная часть |
|---|---|
| If I **had** a car, | I **would drive** to work. |
| If she **knew** the answer, | she **would tell** us. |
| If we **didn't live** here, | we **wouldn't know** them. |

## Утверждение / отрицание / вопрос
| | Форма |
|---|---|
| + | I would go → I'd go |
| − | I would not go → I wouldn't go |
| ? | Would you go? — Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't. |

## Формулы
> **If** + подлежащее + **Past simple**, подлежащее + **would** + глагол
> Подлежащее + **would** + глагол + **if** + подлежащее + **Past simple**

## Запомните
- Никакого **would** прямо после **if**.
- **If I were you ...** — стандартная фраза совета.
- Past simple здесь — не прошлое, а «нереальное»: *If I had* = «если бы у меня было сейчас».
- Неправильные глаголы: had, went, knew, saw, won, took, bought, could (can → could).

exercises.title: Past simple и would
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глаголы в скобках в нужную форму.

items.text: If I {{had}} a car, I {{would drive|'d drive}} to work. (have / drive)
If she {{knew}} the answer, she {{would tell|'d tell}} us. (know / tell)
We {{would travel|'d travel}} a lot if we {{had}} more money. (travel / have)
If I {{lived}} by the sea, I {{would swim|'d swim}} every day. (live / swim)
If you {{studied}} more, you {{would pass|'d pass}} the exam. (study / pass)
They {{wouldn't be|would not be}} late if they {{left}} earlier. (not be / leave)
What {{would}} you do if you {{won}} a lot of money? (would / win)

exercises.title: If I were you ...
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужное слово, чтобы дать совет.

items.text: If I {{were|was}} you, I'd go to the doctor.
If I {{were|was}} you, I {{would|'d}} take a taxi.
If I {{were|was}} you, I {{wouldn't|would not}} buy that coat. It's too expensive.
I'd help her if I {{were|was}} you.
If I {{were|was}} you, I {{would|'d}} learn English.

items.q: If I ___ rich, I would buy an island.
If she ___ more time, she would learn French.
I ___ a bigger flat if I had more money.
What would you do if you ___ a ghost?
If it ___ so cold, we would go out.
I wouldn't ___ it if I were you.
___ you be happy if you lived abroad?
У меня нет машины. Как сказать «Если бы у меня была машина, я бы ездил на ней»?
options: If I have a car, I'll drive it.
If I had a car, I would drive it.
If I would have a car, I drive it.

items.q: Может, завтра будет дождь. Как сказать «Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома»?
options: If it rained, we would stay at home.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If it will rain, we stay at home.

items.q: Как дать совет «На твоём месте я бы позвонил»?
options: If I am you, I would call.
If I were you, I would call.
If I would be you, I call.

items.q: Как сказать «Если бы я знал, я бы сказал»?
options: If I knew, I would tell you.
If I know, I would tell you.
If I knew, I will tell you.

items.q: Как спросить «Что бы ты сделал, если бы выиграл?»
options: What do you do if you win?
What would you do if you won?
What will you do if you would win?
